title: AmpScan, a Rust CLI tool for checking network security and exposed services
content_md:
AmpScan è uno strumento CLI sviluppato in Rust per verificare la sicurezza delle reti e individuare servizi potenzialmente esposti ad attacc

via Mastodon https://www.linuxeasy.org/ampscan-uno-scanner-di-rete-open-per-individuare-vulnerabilita-ddos/
exclude_reason: Tool announcement (AmpScan CLI); not a security event, vulnerability, or breach.
